info.name: Pet Care - Caregiver Delegation E2E
info.description:
E2E cho module Caregiver Delegation (M04, FSM-3, RULE-04-04..09).

Chay doc lap duoc: folder '01 - Auth' dang nhap 2 tai khoan seed cua DevAccountSeeder,
nen khong can OTP qua email.

Diem mau chot: moi loi moi deu gui toi mot email CHUA co tai khoan, nen token duoc
tra ve ngay trong response (spec D-02 nhanh 2) — Postman khong can doc log email.
Nguoi bam accept la caregiver B dang dang nhap, hop le theo spec A-02 (token-bearer:
khi caregiver_user_id con NULL thi ai cam token va dang dang nhap se duoc gan).

Yeu cau backend chay voi: --app.dev-seed.enabled=true
